HER-2 testing represents a key therapeutic and prognostic factor in breast cancer, and that it is performed by FISH and ICH.
HER-2 testing represents the ideal screening approach to breast cancer patients, and should be routinely performed in all patients with breast cancer.
HER-2 is overexpressed in 15%-30% of breast cancers, and that HER-2 testing should be performed using IHC as the screening method of choice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a methodologically correct approach to HER-2 testing.
the comparison of IHC and FISH assays in a series of 100 cases of primary invasive breast carcinoma.
a critical evaluation of the most common methods for HER-2 determination in breast cancer.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
HER-2 is an essential prognostic and/or predictive marker in breast cancer.
the FISH test is the gold standard method for HER- 2/neu determination and that the IHC method is the most cost-effective and reliable method for screening purposes.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HER-2 testing represents the ideal screening procedure for breast cancer.
IHC represents the first line method for HER- 2 testing, and FISH the second line method.
HER-2 testing represents an indispensable step in the diagnostic algorithm of breast cancer.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IHC is a reliable and valid screening method for HER2/neu testing.
HER-2 testing should be carried out in every breast cancer case, regardless of clinical stage, and should be performed utilizing a standardized method.
